fixture.kind: SYNTHETIC text-to-speech gate fixture, not a recording
fixture.transcript:
The weather service issued its seasonal outlook on the ninth of March, and the numbers were unusual. In the northern valleys, the average March temperature came in at 3.4 degrees Celsius, roughly 2.1 degrees below the thirty year mean, and snow cover reached 41 centimetres at the twelve hundred metre station, the deepest reading since 2014. Rainfall across the eastern plain totalled 118 millimetres for the month, about 76 percent of the normal figure, and the river gauge at Millbrook recorded a peak flow of 62 cubic metres per second on the twenty second, falling to 24 by the end of the month.

Farmers responded quickly. Sowing on the heavy clay soils slipped by an average of 12 days, from the 18th of April to the 30th, and seed rates rose from 145 kilograms per hectare to 168, a 16 percent increase, because germination was expected to be uneven. Two growers in the Kesteven district reported that their pumps ran for 340 hours in March alone, nearly double the 180 hours logged a year earlier, and the co-operative ordered 9 additional sprinkler units at a cost of 2,350 pounds each.

The council's engineer cautioned against panic. Reservoir storage stood at 71 percent of capacity on the first of April, against 83 percent in the same week of 2023, and the supply model assumed a daily demand of 410 million litres, an increase of 6 percent. He estimated that voluntary restrictions would begin around the twentieth of June if rainfall stayed below 40 millimetres per month for three consecutive months, and he asked households to fit meters, because a leaking cistern wastes 250 litres a day, and nobody notices a cistern.

embedding_matrix.kind: HF audio embeddings for the committed fixture: the matrix HF splices into the prompt at the <|audio|> placeholders (proj_out output of the audio encoder + projector)
embedding_matrix.layout: row-major C order, little-endian, no header: byte offset (r*2048+c)*4
embedding_matrix.cast_note: no cast: the model loads at dtype=torch.float32 and get_audio_features returns that dtype, so the saved bytes are the values HF splices into the prompt

tower_fp32_test.kind: test of the hypothesis 'HF runs the audio tower in bf16 and ITS rounding grows with position, so HF - not our encoder - is the outlier in the proj_out position-decay comparison'

model.cast: from_pretrained(dtype=torch.float32) is the loader (the checkpoint stores BF16 for all 539 tensors, so this is the bf16 -> fp32 widening); each arm then casts the encoder + projector explicitly with .to(dtype=...), and tower_dtype_audit asserts the result

premise.committed_matrix_cast_note: no cast: the model loads at dtype=torch.float32 and get_audio_features returns that dtype, so the saved bytes are the values HF splices into the prompt
premise.note: the committed golden matrix is recorded by the golden itself as a torch.float32 run with cast_applied=false, produced on CPU: it is HF-fp32, not the bf16 side the hypothesis needs. The bf16 arm here is run explicitly, so 'fp32 vs the golden' reads as HF-fp32(GPU) vs HF-fp32(CPU) (a device check) and the dtype question is answered by the fp32-vs-bf16 pair against the C reference.
